Jouansai"The space is narrow. A warrior's greatest advantage, flight, is of no use here. Take away the hawk's wings, and a rat can give it trouble. Quite reasonable, no?"
Kageaki"...The beak remains. Equal to a rat's teeth, or worse than equal—that is still a rather disappointing hawk, I would think."
Jouansai"Other circumstances also apply. I need not force a victory. Keep you here, and my work is done."
Jouansai"You, however, must defeat me as soon as possible. Even while we speak, my subordinates may arrive."
Kageaki"..."
Jouansai"Time on your side gives composure. Time against you gives impatience. In body, your advantage over me is considerable. In mind, the advantage is mine."
Jouansai"So far, equal. What remains is skill..."
Kageaki(And there, no comparison at all!? That is what he means!?)

en.html:
He moved his body out of my sword's path. Then did it again. In the opening this created, he struck my left wrist.

A joint. Thin armor. The hand remained attached, but the flesh was cut deep.

At last receiving a counterstroke was bad enough. Worse was the business before it: my blade kept missing. He was not even using his sword to block.

Even a block, I could not obtain from him.

Rok toh lo. At least stop the bloody thing. No requirement to suffer an injury, sir; kindly permit my attack to inconvenience you enough that you must raise your sword. Such was the miserable level to which my ambition had fallen.

Make him block, and I could force through. The strength gap between a warrior and an ordinary man was absolute.

This should not have been so difficult. To keep reading a sword's path and avoiding it like that, the difference in ability had to be immense.

Meaning—

Jouansai"...No. A little shallow. At the last instant, you relaxed to receive the blow?"
Kageaki"..."
Jouansai"Battle experience alone will not explain that. You seem to know the swordwork of our Rokuhara Shinkage school."
Kageaki"Once, I crossed blades with a practitioner."
Jouansai"The name?"
Kageaki"Mizuhi Ichigao."
Jouansai"...That girl. Ah. Then it makes sense..."
Jouansai"If you fought her, yes, I understand."
Kageaki"You know of her...?"
Jouansai"Had she not become entangled in that petty corruption affair, I might have brought her into my own service by now. A pity..."
Jouansai"Only a few times I taught her personally, but a genuine gift was there. How is she now?"
Kageaki"...Two years ago, she died for her pride. There is nothing further to say."
Jouansai"...I see..."
Kageaki"You were her teacher?"
Jouansai"It would not be wrong to say so. ...Very well. This too is a connection between people."
Jouansai"The deeper secret I could not fully pass on to her, I shall teach you. Come, then. Attack."
Kageaki"...?"

en.html:
For the first time, the man took a stance.
Sword over his right shoulder. The orthodox high guard of a warrior.

If anything, this seemed to give me an opening. With no stance, his sword could come from anywhere. Now its possible paths were limited; I could read his movement.

Closer to a plain contest of strength, one could say. And in that, the man with no armor was plainly at a disadvantage.

What was he doing?

No time was available for hesitation. An enemy could appear behind me this instant. Whatever he intended, I had to take him on.

I matched his high guard. Measure his breathing, choose the moment—nahin. Against a monster of a swordsman like this, that would be personally digging my grave.

No thought.
I cut.

言うや、男は初めて<ruby>構<rt>かまえ</rt></ruby>を取った。
　刀を右肩上に担ぐ、武者正調の上段。

　それはかえって、隙を生んだように見えた。
　無構と違って太刀筋はある程度限定される。動きを
読み取ることが可能になっている。

　より、単純な力の勝負に近くなったと言ってもいい。
　そうなれば、生身の劣勢は明らかだ。

　何のつもりか？
　
　しかし、躊躇する時間を俺は持たなかった。

　この瞬間にも、後背に敵が現れ得るのだ。
　何があろうと――挑むしかない。


　俺は対手に倣って太刀を上段に取った。
　そして呼吸を――計らない。こんな剣術の化け物の
ような相手にそんな真似をしても墓穴掘りだ。

　何も考えず、
　斬り込む。

　しかし同じ事だ。

　せいぜいが相打ち。
　受ける被害は確実に、相手の方が大きい――
